description: Dept. of  Immigration & Emigration -  Declare that Jaffna, Batticaloa  & Colombo International Airports, shall be on approved port of Entry & Departure
reasoning: This gazette notification contains an order made under the Immigration and Emigration Act (Chapter 351) by the Minister, declaring specific airports as approved ports of entry and departure.
